Topics covered in this PDF

MPSE-012 (State and Society in Australia) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Australian national identity and multiculturalism, the White Australia Policy and its replacement, Will Kymlicka and liberal multiculturalism
  • Settler and Aboriginal nationalism, Hansonism, the Cairns Group and APEC in trade liberalisation

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

How to use the solved PDF properly
